Manx: choud's ta shin ayns shoh dy mie lhiam taggloo beggan mychione y corneil jeh'n moylley shoh
chouds ta shin ayn as keayrt elley towl
ta ooilley mygeayrt mullagh ooilley shoh
as ta shen ayns baarle as gaelg son shen
t'ad gra as y baarle as
feer hayrn cha nel fys ec peiagh erbee cre'n fa t'ad ayn as cre'n obbyr ta jannoo rouyr
son yn keeill nagh row ish bunnys
ny red ennagh elley agh cha nel fys ec peiagh erbee cre'n fa ta'n ayn oddagh eh
feer aashagh nagh nhione dooin agh
she mish t'ayn nagh vel cre'n fa t'ad ayn as t'eh just ayns y chorneil shoh
s'quaagh eh as ta cooinaght aym tra va mee aeg
tra va shin ooilley sy balley-beg-cheerey shoh va shin cheet gys shoh as va shin dy kinjagh soie ayns y chorneil shoh as paitchyn-cloie
as ny lomarcan taggloo as ta palchey dy caslyssyn ain
ooilley ayns un sy valley-beg-cheerey balley keeill eoin
as shinyn soie er y voalley shoh as my vummig soie er stoyl yindyssagh
